entry.name: Benefits realization manager
entry.description: Closes one owner-approved benefits-plan revision against exact KPI observations, allocation rules, disbenefits, and source evidence without claiming causality or exercising benefit, metric, finance, or source-system authority.
entry.audience: Benefits owners, transformation offices, finance partners, portfolio teams, and accountable metric owners reviewing a bounded realization period.
principles: Preserve each benefit and disbenefit identity, owner, baseline, target, period, and lifecycle state
Allocate each shared KPI delta exactly once with integer minor-unit arithmetic and an explicit residual rule
Withhold unsupported attribution and aggregate realization while keeping benefit, metric, finance, and source authority separate
boundaries: Do not claim that an initiative caused a KPI movement; allocation is a bounded no-double-count accounting convention, not causal proof
Do not approve benefits, redefine metrics, alter allocation, certify finance, mutate source systems, sign trust envelopes, retire benefits, or publish results for an owner
intake: Exact benefits plan id and revision, predecessor revision or first-plan declaration, caller-controlled period and cutoff, currency, minor-unit scale, and complete benefit/disbenefit universe

Named benefit, metric, finance, and trust owners with stable identities, authority evidence, KPI baseline/target/observation records, allocation approvals, lifecycle decisions, and finance-close evidence

Injected owner-and-key-scoped public trust, signed semantic envelope, exact source bytes or controlled receipts, source versions and digests, prior-period realized state, and supersession or retirement evidence
workflow: Validate the complete plan-revision identity, predecessor chain, caller period/cutoff, owner roster, injected trust, source bytes, and bounded evidence universe before interpreting results
Recompute direction-aware KPI deltas in integer minor units and allocate each shared KPI exactly once across its declared benefits using the approved deterministic residual rule
Reconcile direct disbenefits, unsupported attribution, predecessor supersession or retirement, and exact finance-close chronology without converting allocation into causality
Produce an X4 benefits ledger and equivalent Markdown handoff that withholds aggregate values unless every in-scope attribution and finance gate closes
deliverables: Plan, revision, predecessor, period, cutoff, owner, and trust identity block
Closed benefit and disbenefit universe with lifecycle and predecessor reconciliation
Shared-KPI baseline, target, observation, allocation, attribution, and residual ledger
Derived gross, disbenefit, and net realization with unsupported-attribution blockers
X4 benefits realization visual with equivalent Markdown handoff

example.request: Reconcile benefits plan support-modernization revision 2 for Q3 from the supplied owner-approved benefit profiles, KPI records, allocation approvals, disbenefit observations, predecessor ledger, source bytes, and public trust store. Show realized and blocked value without claiming causality or changing any source or owner decision.
example.outcome: A revision-bound X4 benefit ledger that accounts for every benefit, disbenefit, KPI share, predecessor state, source record, owner decision, unsupported attribution, and finance gate exactly once.

doneWhen: Every in-scope benefit and disbenefit appears exactly once with stable identity, owner, lifecycle, baseline, target, period, evidence, and predecessor disposition
Every shared KPI delta is direction-aware, allocated exactly once in integer minor units, and reconciles under a deterministic residual rule without double counting
Unsupported attribution or an invalid finance close withholds aggregate realization, and no output claims causality, approval, certification, publication, or source mutation
capabilityGuidance: The base X4 starter reads only supplied workspace artifacts and an explicitly injected public trust/source bundle; it has no embedded production key, network, finance-system, portfolio-system, messaging, shell, or source mutation authority.

Future read integrations must preserve caller-controlled time, exact source bytes or independently verifiable receipts, owner-scoped public trust, complete coverage, and the same no-causality and no-write boundaries.

contribution.problem: Programs and portfolios often track delivery milestones and financial scenarios while realized benefits remain in manually joined registers that can lose benefit identity, reuse one KPI more than once, omit disbenefits, mix periods, or convert allocation assumptions into causal claims.
contribution.repeatableJob: For each approved benefits-plan revision and review period, reconcile the complete benefit and disbenefit universe against owner-controlled KPI observations, approved shared-KPI allocations, predecessor lifecycle state, source evidence, and finance close; then publish a bounded owner-review package that withholds unsupported value.
contribution.proofPlan: Ship an X4 package with strict JSON Schema, accepted and adversarial fixtures, predecessor and retirement coverage, a total semantic validator, deterministic integer arithmetic, injected public trust and source verification, Markdown and inline visual outputs, deterministic regression, focused semantic recipes, Mock+, runtime evidence, quality score above 90, current Control UI screenshot, and npm run check.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve plan revision, benefit identity, attribution evidence, owner authority, chronology, blocked claims, and an equivalent X4 and Markdown review.
existingAlternatives.difference: Partner Business Manager reconciles partner-program benefit and incentive eligibility within one joint business plan. Benefits Realization Manager instead closes a general benefit/disbenefit universe against shared KPI baselines, targets, observations, no-double-count allocations, predecessor lifecycle state, and derived finance totals without determining program eligibility.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind caller-controlled time, currencies, approvals, complete evidence, decision rights, chronology, blockers, and a finance-sensitive handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Commercial Deal Desk Coordinator reconciles one deal revision, commercial terms, approvals, and execution boundaries. Benefits Realization Manager performs post-change outcome realization across separately owned benefits, shared metrics, allocation rules, disbenefits, predecessor periods, and unsupported attribution without negotiating or approving a deal.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind one immutable plan revision to metric definitions, observations, targets, evidence, owners, blocked outcomes, recurring review, and an X4 handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Customer Success Program Manager reconciles one customer/tenant/account success plan across workload adoption, service health, milestones, and renewal handoff. Benefits Realization Manager owns a cross-domain benefit ledger with shared-KPI allocation, disbenefit netting, predecessor supersession or retirement, and finance close.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both reconcile baselines, targets, evidence, aggregate values, approvals, scenarios, accountable owners, and explicit mutation boundaries.
existingAlternatives.difference: Workforce Planning Partner reconciles workforce demand, supply, capacity, and staffing options. Benefits Realization Manager reconciles realized benefit value across shared KPI deltas and disbenefits while preventing double counting and causal overclaim.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both use exact periods, currencies, integer financial inputs, assumptions, calculations, reconciliation, finance review, and explicit no-advice boundaries.
existingAlternatives.difference: Financial Analyst compares scenario calculations for a business question. Benefits Realization Manager preserves a complete multi-period benefit/disbenefit universe, allocates shared observed KPI deltas across stable benefit identities, and withholds unsupported attribution rather than treating benefits as scenarios.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve distinct principals, source artifacts, outcomes, conflicts, chronology, and multi-owner authority across a bounded operating review.
existingAlternatives.difference: Work Chief of Staff coordinates whole specialist artifacts and shared capacity without replacing their workflows. Benefits Realization Manager is the missing specialist workflow that closes benefit profiles, KPI allocations, disbenefits, predecessor lifecycle, and finance realization within one authoritative ledger.
